question: If no radar sample from one class is used to fit the radar model, can the existing contact classifier recognize that class through the radar encoder?
status: Declared before this leave-one-radar-class experiment; existing previously inspected development recordings, not a newly blind dataset
head: Unmodified per-fold stage_b_v0 retained_head_v1 weight10/bias10, grouped into four labels normal/inner/outer/ball
allowed_prior_knowledge: The pretrained contact backbone and previously fitted contact head already have all four classes. This is radar-class holdout, NOT entire-system zero-shot and NOT absence of target-class contact knowledge.
data_exclusion: For each fold/class, exclude that class from ALL radar fitting, including source recording and target recording, min-max/scaler, code fitting, minibatches, losses, model selection and stopping. Student only sees the other three source recordings. Radar scaler and contact scaler use only these three source recordings, recording-balanced. Heldout class source radar is not evaluated.
contact_target: Only corresponding three contact training-recording mean features are used as student targets. Frozen head knowledge of the fourth class remains allowed.
artificial_codes: Construct only three codes for the three seen labels using frozen four-class head, global three-class train-contact mean/scale; 400 Adam steps lr.05, CE+.001 standardized code L2. No class-specific real contact mean enters code construction.
student: Original 128-128-LayerNorm-GELU-Dropout(.1)-64-GELU-128 MLP; zero initialize last linear; output ReLU(contact_mean + contact_scale*net). Same initialization and mini-batch draws for each method under a seed.
training: 400 steps, AdamW lr=.001 weight_decay=.01, gradient clip5; 16 replacement samples per seen training recording each step
loss: CE-only; standardized bag MSE-only; full=CE+MSE+.1 contrast(tau .2)+.5 KD(T2); artificial-code MSE-only. Four-output head retained for every method.
selection: No validation selection, no best seed/class/step selection, all 96 final-step results reported
evaluation: Only the four opposite-direction recordings. Report all4, seen3, unseen1 separately at window and recording(mean probabilities) level. Report heldout recall and seen-to-heldout false prediction rate. Standardized mean feature MSE/cosine descriptive only, fitted scale fixed from seen3.
limitations: One training recording per seen fault; same physical bearings between directions; previously developed data. Success does not by itself prove severity, causal physics or broad generalization. Failure means this existing training recipe lacks this demonstrated capability, not that all cross-modal transfer is impossible.
environment: m2vllm, CPU 2 threads, no original files overwritten
